adapter.rate_note: Anonymous Discourse API; the forum applies Discourse's per-IP rate limits (429 with Retry-After). One request per second.
adapter.terms: Roblox Developer Forum content; posting or replying needs a Roblox account with forum access. Link back to the topic when reusing it.

search_postings.note: GET /search.json?q=<query> category:82 order:latest&page=<page> (Discourse 'Search for a term'), restricted to the Collaboration › Find and Hire Talent ('Post job listings to hire talent.') category (id 82) and newest first. `query` is REQUIRED in practice: without it no q is sent and Discourse returns no topics. Discourse search takes at least 3 characters and supports its advanced filters inside the query (e.g. tags:scripter, after:2026-09-01). category and min_budget are not sent (no budget field on forum topics). Pages hold up to 50 topics (limit is not sent). title/posted_at are the topic's; description is the search excerpt; the topic URL is https://devforum.roblox.com/t/<id>. Posters are matched in the response's separate posts[] list (raw is per topic), so buyer is null here — use get_posting.

get_posting.note: GET /t/{id}.json ('Get a single topic'): buyer = the topic creator's username, description = the first post's HTML (post_stream.posts[0].cooked); skills = the topic's tags. The topic URL is https://devforum.roblox.com/t/<id>.

not_offered.me: Anonymous read-only access; a user API key would need the forum's user-api-key flow, which is not configured for third-party clients here.
not_offered.submit_bid: Forum recruitment threads have no application object; candidates reply or message the poster on the forum with an account.
not_offered.list_messages: Private messages need a logged-in user API key; anonymous access cannot read them.
not_offered.send_message: Posting or messaging needs a logged-in account on the forum; anonymous API access is read-only.
not_offered.credits: No account, credit or balance concept on the forum.
